description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI, testing various API endpoints such as getAll, getOne, create, delete, and update for employee attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes test data setup, mock service registration, and test case execution to verify API behavior.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all employee attendance records via API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single employee attendance record, expected to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rule for the getOne method, expected to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee attendance record via API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee attendance record via API.
